note: The Taxicab(5, 2, n) problem asks whether any positive integer can be expressed as the sum of two fifth powers in at least two different ways. While the classical taxicab problem (for cubes) dates to Edward B. Escott in 1897, the specific origin year for the fifth power variant is not documented in available sources. It appears to be a natural generalization of the classical problem but the year it was first posed remains unknown.
